exposure: Presence or absence of peripartum congestive heart failure (PCHF)
cohort: 2,115,873 birth-mothers in Taiwan between 1997 and 2013, including 512 with PCHF
finding: Maternal structural heart diseases, pulmonary diseases, thyroid disorders, and pre-existing or gestational hypertension are associated with an increased risk of developing peripartum congestive heart failure (PCHF).
mod_finding: The study found that patients with peripartum congestive heart failure had a higher rate of cesarean sections compared to those without.
